A standard marathon is exactly **42.195 kilometers** (or **26 miles and 385 yards**).

This specific distance was standardized by the International Association of Athletics Federations (IAAF) in 1921, adopting the length used at the 1908 London Olympics. Prior to that, marathon distances varied slightly between events, typically ranging around 40 km (25 miles). Today, all official marathons worldwide adhere to this precise measurement.
